## Savings Tips for All Ages


Having a healthy savings account is a vital part of a successful financial future, and starting early is even more important. Help your kids start their savings journey and elevate your savings with one of the many different options at Virginia National Bank.


Abbie Ford, Chief Corporate Services Officer at VNB, has some great tips for anyone at any age start building or elevate their savings to reach their financial goals. Listen to our latest podcast episode and discover many ways to save.


### Follow[Virginia National Bank: My Forever Bank](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/virginia-national-bank-my-forever-bank/id6805109463) wherever you listen to podcasts.


##


### DOGWOOD SAVINGS


- Minimum opening deposit of $10
- Minor account - for clients under 18 years of age
- Limit of 6 withdrawal items per month, $10 each if over 6
- No monthly minimum balance
- No monthly maintenance fee
- Market interest rate earned on all balances greater than $10
- Interest rate may change
- Fees may reduce earnings


### CERTIFICATE OF DEPOSIT


- Minimum opening deposit of $500, unless otherwise stated
- Terms of 3 months to 5 years
- 10 day grace period after maturity for withdrawals
- Penalty for early withdrawal, forfeiture of interest, regardless if earned, as follows: 3 months' forfeiture for CD with term of 1 year or less; 6 months' forfeiture for CD with term greater than 1 year
- Automatic renewal
- Interest paid quarterly
